app.name: Walplay
app.tagline: A calm place to discover films and series worth your time.

empty.title: Your next watch starts here
empty.description: Walplay is a calm place to discover films and series worth your time. Discovery features are not part of this foundation yet, so there is nothing to browse here today.

browse.title: Start browsing
browse.description: Open the catalog to see what is trending, popular, and top rated right now.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Choose how Walplay speaks to you. This page contains only the preferences available in this early foundation.

language.label: Interface language
language.helper: Changes apply immediately and are saved only in this browser.
language.storageNotice: Your language preference is stored only in this browser. It may be lost if you clear browser storage or use another device.

error.title: This page could not be loaded
error.description: Something went wrong while preparing this page. Try again, or return home.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you requested does not exist. It may have moved, or the address may be mistyped.

empty.title: Nothing here yet
empty.description: There is no content to show right now.

config.title: Walplay cannot start
config.description: The application is missing valid configuration. Please contact the site owner or try again later.

render.title: This page could not be displayed
render.description: A problem stopped this page from rendering. The rest of the application is still available.

form.label: Search movies and TV shows
form.hint: Enter at least {{min}} characters and no more than {{max}}.

initial.title: Find something to watch
initial.description: Search by title to see movies and TV shows together.

guidance.tooShort: Enter at least {{min}} characters to search.
guidance.tooLong: Enter no more than {{max}} characters to search.

queryInvalid.title: This search cannot be completed
queryInvalid.description: Check the title and try a different search.

noResults.title: No titles matched “{{query}}”
noResults.description: Check the spelling or try a different title. You can edit or clear the search above.

unavailable.title: Search is temporarily unavailable
unavailable.description: Search could not be completed right now. Try again, or use the rest of the application.

rateLimited.title: Search is temporarily limited
rateLimited.description: Too many requests reached the provider. Try again in a moment.

timedOut.title: Search took too long
timedOut.description: The provider did not answer in time. Try again.

states.interimEmpty: This page had no titles. Load more to keep looking.

pageError.title: More results could not be loaded
pageError.description: Your current results are still available. Try loading this page again.

empty.title: No titles available right now
empty.description: There are no titles to show here at the moment. Try again shortly.

error.title: This section could not be loaded
error.description: The catalog is temporarily unavailable here. Try again, or keep browsing other sections.

pageError.title: The catalog could not be loaded
pageError.description: Catalog titles are temporarily unavailable. Try again, or use the rest of the application.

rateLimited.title: The catalog is temporarily limited
rateLimited.description: Too many requests reached the catalog provider. Try again in a moment.

timedOut.title: The catalog took too long
timedOut.description: The catalog provider did not answer in time. Try again.

states.endOfList: You have reached the end of the list.

notFound.title: Title not found
notFound.description: This title is not available in the catalog. It may have been removed, or the address may be mistyped.

unavailable.title: Title details are unavailable
unavailable.description: This title could not be loaded right now. Try again, or return to the catalog.

attribution.statement: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

detail.providerValuesNote: Ratings and popularity are provided by TMDB and may change.

empty.title: No episodes available
empty.description: TMDB does not list episodes for this season.

error.title: Title details are unavailable
error.description: This title could not be loaded right now. Try again, or return to the catalog.

sectionError.title: This section could not be loaded
sectionError.description: Try again to load this section. The rest of the page is still available.

notFound.title: Title not found
notFound.description: This title is not available. It may have been removed, or the address may be mistyped.

availability.regionUnsupported: Availability information is not available for {{region}} yet. Choose another region.

freshness.caution: Availability may have changed since this information was checked.

noInformation.title: Availability information not found
noInformation.description: We could not find availability information for {{region}}. This does not mean the title is unavailable; it may still be available. You can check the availability source or a provider directly.

error.title: Availability could not be loaded
error.description: Availability information is temporarily unavailable. Try again. The rest of the title page is still available.

availability.disclaimer: Availability is informational, region-specific, and may change. It is not a guarantee that the title can be watched. Walplay does not host or stream content.

disclosure.loads: Activating a video loads content from {{platform}}.
disclosure.privacyNote: Privacy-enhanced playback limits personalization. It does not eliminate third-party processing.
disclosure.hostingNote: Walplay does not host these videos.

player.title: {{title}} — {{platform}} player
player.captionNote: Captions are controlled by {{platform}} and the video’s owner.

noVideos.title: No trailer information available
noVideos.description: There is no promotional video information for this title right now.

error.title: Trailer information is unavailable
error.description: This section could not be loaded. Try again; the rest of the page is still available.

stale.caution: This information may be out of date.

unavailable.title: This video cannot be played here
unavailable.description: The video’s owner may have disabled embedding, or the video may be private, deleted, age-restricted, unavailable in your region, or blocked by your network.

externalOnly.title: The player cannot be shown at this width
externalOnly.description: Open the video on {{platform}} to watch it.

announce.unavailable: This video cannot be played here. An external option is available.
announce.externalOnly: A compliant player cannot be shown here. An external option is available.

watchlist.title: Your watchlist is empty
watchlist.description: Save a movie or TV show from its details to plan what to watch next.

favorites.title: No favorites yet
favorites.description: Mark a movie or TV show as a favorite from its details to find it here.

error.title: Saved titles are unavailable
error.description: Saved titles could not be loaded right now. Try again.

entry.notInCatalog: No longer available in the catalog.
entry.unreadable: This saved title can't be read.

feedback.saveFailed: {{title}} could not be saved on this device. Try again.
feedback.removeFailed: {{title}} could not be removed. Try again.
feedback.sessionOnly: This change applies only to this session because this browser cannot store saved titles.
feedback.watchlistCleared: Your watchlist was deleted from this device.
feedback.favoritesCleared: Your favorites were deleted from this device.
feedback.allCleared: All saved titles were deleted from this device.
feedback.dataReset: Saved titles were reset on this device.

storageNotice.title: Saved on this device only
storageNotice.description: Saved titles stay in this browser on this device. They can be lost if you clear browsing data, use private browsing, or change browser or device. They are not synchronized across devices.
storageNotice.hint: Saved titles stay on this device only.

manage.title: Manage saved titles on this device
manage.description: Deleting removes these titles from this browser. This cannot be undone.

recovery.title: Saved titles could not be read
recovery.description: The saved data on this device is damaged or comes from a newer version of Walplay. Reload the page, or reset the saved data to start again.

explanation.basis: This section shows the provider's popular titles. It is not personalized.
explanation.savedTitles: Walplay does not use the titles you saved to choose these suggestions.
explanation.noAi: Walplay does not apply AI or machine learning to your activity and does not create a separate visitor profile.
explanation.scope: You are browsing as a guest. Personalized recommendations are not available in guest mode.
explanation.retention: Your saved lists stay in this browser and may be lost if you clear browsing data.
explanation.controls: You can switch between movies and TV shows and try again if something fails. Guest mode has no personalization controls.

popular.heading: Popular now
popular.basis: Based on provider popularity, not personalized

noProvider.title: No suggestions are available right now
noProvider.description: The provider did not return any popular titles to show. Try again or browse the catalog.

allExcluded.title: No suggestions are left to show
allExcluded.description: The available popular titles are already in your saved lists. Browse the catalog or search for another title.

error.title: This area could not be loaded
error.description: Suggestions are temporarily unavailable. Try again or keep browsing.

rateLimited.title: Suggestions are temporarily limited
rateLimited.description: Too many requests reached the provider. Try again in a moment.

timedOut.title: Suggestions took too long
timedOut.description: The provider did not answer in time. Try again.

stale.label: These suggestions were loaded earlier and may not be current.
